wants.topic: Historical nostalgia framing of festivals ('100 years ago' / 1920s vintage perspective)
wants.evidence: The Divine Journey videos on 1926 Chhath Puja (45.18x vsNormal), 1926 Dhanteras (36.02x vsNormal), and 1926 Diwali (31.08x vsNormal).

wants.topic: Devotional moral Kathas featuring divine grace on the poor (Lakshmi blessing poor devotees / Daridrata trials)
wants.evidence: Mooli Toons TV 'गरीब कुम्हारिन के कुटिया में आईं मां लक्ष्मी' (18.24x vsNormal) and 18 Puranas 'माता लक्ष्मी और दरिद्रता की परीक्षा' (28.58x vsNormal).

wants.topic: Festival Kathas driven by family dynamics (Devrani-Jethani, Bhabhi-Nanad conflicts resolved by divine intervention)
wants.evidence: 18 Puranas videos: 'घमंडी जेठानी का सोने का सूप vs देवरानी' (5.83x vsNormal) and Bhai Dooj 'भाभी का सोना vs बहन का चौमुखी दीपक' (3.62x vsNormal).

gaps: Emotional storytelling behind specific ritual traditions (e.g., origin of Chhath Soop or Yamdeep) rather than dry Vrat recitations.
Immersive historical context videos exploring ancient Indian village celebrations across different eras.
saturated: Generic Pitru Paksha / Garuda Puran death and afterlife explainers without narrative hooks (scored 0x vsNormal).
Standard, repetitive Vrat Kathas (e.g., Papankusha Ekadashi) recited like textbook audio.
